Name: MILimbEEG: Motor and motor-imagery limb EEG dataset (MILimbEEG)
EthicsApprovals: Approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) of the Smart Data Analysis Systems Group (SDAS Group) (meeting minutes IBR-SG-2022-001). All procedures were in accordance with the ethical standards of the institutional/national research committee and with the 1964 Declaration of Helsinki, and informed consent was obtained from all participants (Asanza et al. 2023, Data in Brief 49:109540, DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2023.109540).
